person_note: The controlling narration is third person, chiefly focalized through Sam and Nisha and sometimes Phil. Multiple Goodreads event passages show an external narrator reporting characters' actions and thoughts, while the authorized opening independently demonstrates sustained close third-person narration. BookRags' whole-book structural account confirms that later shifts are between character storylines within third person, not between grammatical persons. Apparent first-person material is dialogue or direct thought, and apparent second-person material is universal advice, imperatives, or thought content. The publisher excerpt covers only Chapter One, but the whole-book description and interior quote evidence remove the main scope uncertainty; no credible contrary structure was found.
